prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1496; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable umbrella or excess coverage, along with the policy declarations page. We also ask that you identify the claim handler assigned to this file.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to this loss is preserved. This includes the insured's recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and total-loss appraisals, dash camera footage, telematics records, and any witness statements or police-related materials in your possession. Any vehicle involved should not be repaired, salvaged, or disposed of until both parties have had a reasonable opportunity to inspect it.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
